SAIDEEP BHOSALE Delivery Manager – Payment Systems | Agile Practitioner | Banking IT Services +91- 9146445858 | Pune, Maharashtra |

bhosalesaideep@gmail.com

LinkedIn

PROFILE SUMMARY

Dynamic and outcome-driven Delivery Manager with 12+ years of experience leading enterprise payment platforms, banking technology integrations, and large-scale multi-country rollouts. Specialized in card payment processing, issuer/acquirer systems, POS & eCommerce integrations, PCI- DSS compliance, EMV, tokenization, and ISO 8583 banking protocols.

Currently driving delivery excellence at AurusTech, overseeing multi-million-dollar payment programs for Fortune 500 retailers and financial institutions. Adept at managing cross-functional engineering squads, vendor ecosystems, regulatory compliance, risk mitigation, and enterprise program governance.

Proven track record in delivering bank-grade, highly available, secure transaction systems aligned with the standards of leading banks such as JPMC, Citi, HSBC, Barclays, and Deutsche Bank.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Payment Gateway & Switch Integration

Merchant Acquiring & Issuing Bank Systems

EMV, NFC, Contactless, PCI-DSS Compliance

Agile Project Management (Scrum/SAFe)



Stakeholder & Client Relationship Management

Regulatory & Risk Compliance

UAT, SIT, Regression & Deployment Management

Product Roadmap & Budget Management

Banking APIs (REST, ISO 8583), Reconciliation



Incident Management (L2/L3), Root Cause Analysis

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Delivery Manager – Payments & Banking Technology AurusTech Pvt. Ltd., Pune | April 2025 – Present



Leading enterprise delivery portfolios across POS, eCommerce, and in-store payment ecosystems for global BFSI and retail clients.

Overseeing end-to-end delivery governance, roadmap management, risk controls, compliance

reviews, and budget tracking.

Driving integrations with acquiring processors, issuer banks, and digital wallet networks

including ApplePay, GooglePay, PayPal, and regional banking wallets.

Managing multi-country rollout programs, ensuring predictable delivery using Agile/Scrum and

SAFe frameworks.

Ensuring platform compliance with PCI-DSS, EMV, P2PE, tokenization, encryption (DUKPT), and

HSM-based security.

Collaborating with engineering, QA, cloud, security & PMO teams to deliver high-availability



payment systems with <100ms latency. Leading client escalations, SLA management, root cause reviews, and governance presentations with banking & retail leadership.

Project Manager – Payments AurusTech Pvt. Ltd., Pune | April 2018 – March 2025

Managed complex POS/eCommerce payment programs for enterprise clients across US, Canada,

and APAC.

Delivered payment routing engine enhancements, interchange optimization features, fraud

monitoring, and token vault integrations.

Coordinated with processors such as Fiserv, Elavon, Chase, Worldpay, ensuring certification and

compliance readiness.

Oversaw product backlog, sprint planning, resource allocation, and cost planning for high-



volume payment systems. Led PCI-DSS audits, EMV certifications, PIN encryption rollouts, and secure key management initiatives.

Client Services Manager – Payments AurusTech Pvt. Ltd., Pune | April 2017 – March 2018

Managed payment gateway operations, KPIs (latency, declines, settlement), and production



health checks. Led issue triaging with processors and bank tech teams.

Developed functional/technical documents for bank audits, certifications, and architectural

assessments.

Technical Support Engineer – Payment Infrastructure AurusTech Pvt. Ltd., Pune | Jan 2016 – March 2017



Supported 24x7 enterprise payment systems handling high volumes of card-present & CNP transactions.

Executed device certifications, key rollovers, L2/L3 incident resolution, and EMV/PED

maintenance.

Assistant Professor / Academic Consultant

Finolex Academy, Ratnagiri | Dec 2011 – Dec 2015

Software Development Intern

Mahindra Hinoday, Pune | Jan 2011 – Nov 2011

EDUCATION

Masters in Computer Applications – Mumbai University – 2011 Bachelor of Computer Science – Mumbai University – 2007

CERTIFICATIONS

Certified Scrum Master (CSM) • Agile Project Manager (ICP-APM) • PCI-DSS Compliance & EMV Fundamentals (Internal Training) • Generative AI Overview for Project Managers

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY STACK

Payments: EMV, NFC, DUKPT, Tokenization, ISO 8583, HSM, PEDs Frameworks: Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Waterfall Tools: Jira, Confluence, QC, Basecamp, PPM Platforms: Windows, Linux, Ubuntu, CentOSS

KEY ACCOMPLISHMENTS

Promoted to Delivery Manager for consistent high-quality delivery across payment programs. • Awarded Star Performer for delivering a global retail payment transformation under budget and ahead of schedule. Led multi-brand POS and eCommerce payment rollouts across 5000+ stores.

• Orchestrated a multi-tender acceptance platform including credit, debit, gift cards, crypto wallets, ApplePay, GooglePay.

Resolved long-standing PED–POS integration issues across major retail chains through optimized

infrastructure and device strategy.

PROJECT DETAILS

Delivered solutions across Health, Apparel, Grocery, Auto, C-Store, Lifestyle, Specialty Retail including:

National EMV upgrade programs, contactless enablement & M400 deployments. • eCommerce payment gateway onboarding with tokenized cards, digital wallets & 3DS flows. • Reconciliation & settlement APIs for Chase and other processors. • PINless debit implementation and multi-processor certification (Fiserv). • POS–PED mapping strategy redesign to eliminate IP-mismatch-driven outages. • Multi-brand digital payment onboarding for new eCommerce storefronts. • Youth & Lifestyle Retail – Delivered PINless debit support and coordinated certifications with Fiserv and store QA teams. Supported eCommerce payments testing including PINless fallback and ApplePay token validation in staging and production.

Apparel & Retail – Led support for post-release issues including POS-PED integration validation, PED version upgrades, and transaction communication recovery in coordination with the client's network team. Also supported QA and rollout of digital transaction flow via web-based test harness and token-based payments.

CERTIFICATIONS
Certified Scrum Master (CSM) • Agile Project Manager (ICP-APM) • PCI-DSS Compliance & EMV Fundamentals (Internal Training) • Generative AI Overview for Project Managers
TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY STACK
Payments: EMV, NFC, DUKPT, Tokenization, ISO 8583, HSM, PEDs Frameworks: Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Waterfall Tools: Jira, Confluence, QC, Basecamp, PPM Platforms: Windows, Linux, Ubuntu, CentOSS
KEY ACCOMPLISHMENTS
Promoted to Delivery Manager for consistent high-quality delivery across payment programs. • Awarded Star Performer for delivering a global retail payment transformation under budget and ahead of schedule. Led multi-brand POS and eCommerce payment rollouts across 5000+ stores.
• Orchestrated a multi-tender acceptance platform including credit, debit, gift cards, crypto wallets, ApplePay, GooglePay.
Resolved long-standing PED–POS integration issues across major retail chains through optimized
infrastructure and device strategy.
PROJECT DETAILS
Delivered solutions across Health, Apparel, Grocery, Auto, C-Store, Lifestyle, Specialty Retail including:
National EMV upgrade programs, contactless enablement & M400 deployments. • eCommerce payment gateway onboarding with tokenized cards, digital wallets & 3DS flows. • Reconciliation & settlement APIs for Chase and other processors. • PINless debit implementation and multi-processor certification (Fiserv). • POS–PED mapping strategy redesign to eliminate IP-mismatch-driven outages. • Multi-brand digital payment onboarding for new eCommerce storefronts. • Youth & Lifestyle Retail – Delivered PINless debit support and coordinated certifications with Fiserv and store QA teams. Supported eCommerce payments testing including PINless fallback and ApplePay token validation in staging and production.
Apparel & Retail – Led support for post-release issues including POS-PED integration validation, PED version upgrades, and transaction communication recovery in coordination with the client's network team. Also supported QA and rollout of digital transaction flow via web-based test harness and token-based payments.
